description: This file contains unit tests for the SessionManagementServer component, verifying its initialization, connection handling, disconnection, and log level settings. It uses the Google Test framework and references external system headers.

methods.name: shouldInitializeServer
methods.description: Test that the server initializes successfully.

methods.name: shouldFailToInitializeServer
methods.description: Test that server initialization failure is handled correctly.

methods.name: shouldStartServer
methods.description: Test that the server starts properly.

methods.name: shouldEstablishConnection
methods.description: Test that a client can establish a connection with the server.

methods.name: shouldDisconnectFromClient
methods.description: Test that the server can disconnect from a client.

methods.name: shouldSetLogLevels
methods.description: Test that log levels can be set correctly.
